title: Mysterious billionaire shows off ‘America’s oil’ — and Trump’s Venezuela
summary_full: A visit to the petroleum-rich Orinoco Belt revealed a nascent U.S.-backed oil empire in a vassal state where officials once railed against the imperial north.
